lines.text: Ezra gathered the exiles at the Ahava canal, found no Levites, and sent leaders to Iddo at Casiphia.
By God's gracious hand, Sherebiah and his sons and brothers came, and 220 temple servants were also brought.
Ezra proclaimed a feast by the Ahava Canal to ask God for a safe journey, and God granted their request.
Ezra set apart twelve leading priests, weighed silver, gold and articles to them, and told them to guard it carefully.
At God's house, Meremoth received the silver and gold with Eleazar son of Aaron, and exiles offered 96 rams.
